TENSION v1.0.0 - Installation Instructions
===========================================

INSTALLATION:
1. Double-click "TENSION.pkg"
2. Follow the installation prompts
3. The installer will copy TENSION to your system folders:
   - VST3: ~/Library/Audio/Plug-Ins/VST3/TENSION.vst3
   - AU: ~/Library/Audio/Plug-Ins/Components/TENSION.component

FIRST USE (IMPORTANT):
macOS will show a security warning because this plugin is not signed.

To bypass Gatekeeper:
1. Open your DAW (Logic Pro, Ableton, etc.)
2. When you first load TENSION, macOS will block it
3. Go to System Settings > Privacy & Security
4. Scroll down and click "Open Anyway" next to the TENSION warning
5. Confirm you want to open it

You only need to do this once per plugin format (VST3 and AU).

If the PKG itself won't open ("unidentified developer"), right-click the
PKG and choose Open once.

PLUGIN INFO:
- Version: 1.0.0
- Formats: VST3, AU
- Description: One-knob cinematic tension/riser effect. Automate the
  TENSION knob over 4-32 bars and it builds a full riser from silence -
  noise, filter sweeps, stereo width, delay and reverb, all rising
  together. Three rise modes: Slow Burn / Cinematic / Aggressive.

QUICK START:
Load TENSION on a bus or riser track, pick a RISE MODE, leave MIX at 50%,
and automate the big TENSION knob 0% -> 100% over 8 or 16 bars into your
drop. At 0% the plugin is a bit-exact passthrough.

UNINSTALLATION:
To remove TENSION:
1. Delete ~/Library/Audio/Plug-Ins/VST3/TENSION.vst3
2. Delete ~/Library/Audio/Plug-Ins/Components/TENSION.component
3. Restart your DAW

COMPATIBILITY:
- macOS 14.6 or later recommended
- Built for your Mac architecture (Apple Silicon)
